title: LintConfig
description:
Shared, immutable configuration data wrapped in `Arc` for cheap cloning.

All serializable fields of `LintConfig` live here. When `LintConfig` is
cloned (e.g., in `validate_project` / `validate_project_with_registry`),
only the `Arc` refcount is bumped - no heap-allocated `Vec<String>` or
nested structs are deep-copied. Mutation through setters uses
`Arc::make_mut` for copy-on-write semantics.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for paths to exclude from validation (e.g., ["node_modules/**", "dist/**"])

files.description: File inclusion/exclusion configuration for non-standard agent files

max_files_to_validate.description:
Maximum number of files to validate before stopping.

This is a security feature to prevent DoS attacks via projects with
millions of small files. When the limit is reached, validation stops
with a `TooManyFiles` error.

Default: 10,000 files. Set to `None` to disable the limit (not recommended).

mcp_protocol_version.description: Expected MCP protocol version (deprecated: use spec_revisions.mcp_protocol instead)

overrides.description: Per-file rule suppression overrides (rules disabled for matching paths only)

rules.description: Configuration for enabling/disabling validation rules by category

severity.description: Minimum severity level to report (Error, Warning, Info)

spec_revisions.description: Pin specific specification revisions for revision-aware validation

target.description: Target tool for validation. In config files, use PascalCase enum names (e.g., ClaudeCode, Cursor, Codex, Kiro, Generic). Deprecated: use 'tools' array instead.

tool_versions.description: Pin specific tool versions for version-aware validation

tools.description: Tools to validate for. Valid values: "claude-code", "cursor", "codex", "kiro", "copilot", "github-copilot", "cline", "opencode", "gemini-cli", "amp", "roo-code", "windsurf", "generic"

FilesConfig.description:
File inclusion/exclusion configuration for non-standard agent files.

By default, agnix only validates files it recognizes (CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, etc.).
Use this section to include additional files in validation or exclude files
that would otherwise be validated.

Patterns use glob syntax (e.g., `"docs/ai-rules/*.md"`).
Paths are matched relative to the project root.

Priority: `exclude` > `include_as_memory` > `include_as_generic` > built-in detection.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude from validation

include_as_generic.description: Glob patterns for files to validate as generic markdown (XML, XP, REF rules)

include_as_memory.description: Glob patterns for files to validate as memory/instruction files (ClaudeMd rules)

OverrideConfig.description:
Per-file rule suppression override.

Each `[[overrides]]` block carves a set of rule IDs out of validation for
files matching any of its `paths` globs. Multiple blocks stack (set union)
on top of the global `rules.disabled_rules`. Absent or empty `overrides`
preserves the existing behavior (backwards compatible).

# Example

```toml
[[overrides]]
paths = [".claude/CLAUDE.md", "docs/agents/**/*.md"]
disabled_rules = ["PE-001"]
```

disabled_rules.description: Rule IDs to disable for files matching `paths` (e.g., ["PE-001"])

paths.description: Glob patterns for files this override applies to

RuleConfig.description: Configuration for enabling/disabling validation rules by category

agents.description: Enable Claude Code agents validation rules (CC-AG-*)

disabled_rules.description: List of rule IDs to explicitly disable (e.g., ["CC-AG-001", "AS-005"])

disabled_validators.description: List of validator names to disable (e.g., ["XmlValidator", "PromptValidator"])

frontmatter_validation.description: Validate YAML frontmatter in skill files

generic_instructions.description: Detect generic placeholder instructions in CLAUDE.md

hooks.description: Enable Claude Code hooks validation rules (CC-HK-*)

mcp.description: Enable Model Context Protocol validation rules (MCP-*)

memory.description: Enable Claude Code memory validation rules (CC-MEM-*)

output_styles.description: Enable Claude Code output-style validation rules (CC-OS-*)

plugins.description: Enable Claude Code plugins validation rules (CC-PL-*)

required_fields.description: Deprecated no-op retained for older configs

skills.description: Enable Agent Skills validation rules (AS-*, CC-SK-*)

tool_names.description: Deprecated no-op retained for older configs

xml.description: Enable XML tag balance validation rules (XML-*)

xml_balance.description: Check XML tag balance (legacy: use 'xml' instead)

SpecRevisions.description:
Specification revision pinning for version-aware validation

When spec revisions are pinned, validators can apply revision-specific
rules. When not pinned, validators use the latest known revision.

mcp_protocol.description: MCP protocol version for revision-specific validation (e.g., "2025-11-25", "2024-11-05")

TargetTool.description: Target tool for validation (deprecated: use 'tools' array for multi-tool support)

ToolVersions.description:
Tool version pinning for version-aware validation

When tool versions are pinned, validators can apply version-specific
behavior instead of using default assumptions. When not pinned,
validators will use sensible defaults and add assumption notes.

claude_code.description: Claude Code version for version-aware validation (e.g., "1.0.0")

codex.description: Codex CLI version for version-aware validation (e.g., "0.1.0")

copilot.description: GitHub Copilot version for version-aware validation (e.g., "1.0.0")
